name: hra-rent
description: Thresholds for a rent receipt used to claim house rent allowance: when the landlord's PAN must be given, and when a cash receipt needs a revenue stamp. Both are amounts set by central law, not rates that change every year.

sources.title: Income Tax Department: Form No. 124 (earlier Form No. 12BB) frequently asked questions
sources.notes: Maps Form 12BB / rule 26C of the Income-tax Rules, 1962 to Form 124 / rule 205 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026 and section 192 to section 392(5)(b) of the Income-tax Act, 2025. Question 5: the landlord's PAN must be furnished if the annual rent exceeds ₹1,00,000; Aadhaar is not mandatory unless the employer asks.

sources.title: Income Tax Department: Form No. 12BB (see rule 26C), statement of claims by an employee for deduction of tax under section 192
sources.notes: House rent allowance entry: rent paid to the landlord, and the landlord's name, address and PAN. Note to the entry: PAN shall be furnished if the aggregate rent paid during the previous year exceeds one lakh rupees.

sources.title: The Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (India Code)
sources.notes: Section 30: a person receiving money exceeding twenty rupees must, on demand, give a duly stamped receipt. Schedule I, Article 53: a receipt for money or property exceeding ₹5,000 is chargeable, and exempts a receipt endorsed on a duly stamped instrument or on a cheque or bill of exchange payable on demand.

sources.title: Income Tax Department: Schedule I of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Article 53 (RECEIPT)
sources.notes: The rate column for Article 53 prints "One rupee" for a receipt above ₹5,000, i.e. a ₹1 revenue stamp.

entries.basis: aggregate rent paid during the previous year
entries.notes: Applies to a claim of HRA exemption made to the employer. Above the threshold, leave the landlord's PAN on the receipt and in the claim; below it, the receipt can be issued without one.

entries.basis: a receipt for money, where the payment is in cash
entries.notes: A receipt for more than ₹5,000 is chargeable under Article 53 and the duty printed there is one rupee. A receipt for rent paid by cheque or bill of exchange payable on demand is exempt, so only cash receipts need the stamp in practice.
